instruction: I don't want VLC cluttering my system tray. Could you help me disable the system tray icon so VLC doesn't appear there when minimized?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the system tray icon in VLC. The evaluator checks the qt-system-tray setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 0 (disabled). Default is 1 (enabled). Uses custom check_qt_system_tray__629fd64a metric function.
metadata.verification: Created custom metric function check_qt_system_tray__629fd64a that reads vlcrc file and verifies qt-system-tray=0. Default is 1 (enabled), task requires changing to 0 (disabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) which contains the qt-system-tray setting
Metric logic correctly parses config file, searches for qt-system-tray setting, defaults to '1' if not found (correct default), and compares against expected value 0
Expected value (0) correctly represents disabling the system tray icon as required by instruction
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (disable system tray icon) and evaluator checks exactly that
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure config changes take effect
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (expected.get('expected_qt_system_tray'))
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts config → metric verifies qt-system-tray=0
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: FileNotFoundError exception handling (line 36) occurs after file reading (lines 18-19), so file not found would raise unhandled exception. However, this is unlikely in practice since VLC creates config file and postconfig launches VLC.
